title: Word Master Arcade
intro: Strings are pieces of text! Transform them, measure them, and slice them into pieces. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐!

rounds.explain: .upper() shouts the whole word in CAPITAL letters.
Slicing [0:3] takes letters at 0, 1, 2, that's P, y, t, and stops before 3.
len() counts the characters. "cat" has 3 letters.

rounds.prompt: We want lowercase but the method name is wrong. Pick the fix.
What is the first letter printed?
rounds.explain: Strings are indexed like lists, position 0 is the first letter, M.

rounds.prompt: Build code that stores a word and prints it in CAPITALS.
rounds.explain: Store the string first, then call .upper() on it inside print.
